name: Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. provides railway signaling and traffic management solutions in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Signal Systems Business and Power Electronics Business. It offers railway signaling solutions, including train control and detection equipment, interlocking equipment, block systems, field equipment, level crossing control equipment, total traffic control systems, maintenance equipment, power supply for signaling systems, and railway-related equipment.
